title: Throughput-aware batching counsel with safe rollout automation
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build an advisor service that generates tenant-specific continuous batching and caching recommendations from live workload profiles, validates them via simulation and dry-run, and applies them with incremental canary rollout and automatic rollback triggers. The advisor should combine short-term signals (inter-arrival time, sequence length distribution, KV cache hit rate) with long-term objectives (token cost, p99 latency, SLOs) to produce: (1) a candidate batching configuration (target batch size, max wait ms, dynamic batching window), (2) caching hints (prefix/KV cache lifetime, shard affinity), and (3) a rollout plan (canary percentage steps, ramp duration, validation metrics). The system must be tenant-safe: opt-in, auditable, with a simulation mode that estimates cost/latency delta before apply. Integrate telemetry into Console and Redwood Optimize so PMs and SREs can review suggested changes and approvals.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor can ingest and summarize 7 days of per-tenant request traces and produce a recommended batching profile and caching hints
Simulation mode produces a cost and latency delta estimate within ±10% of observed results in a held-out validation window
Apply API supports dry-run, staged canary rollout (0->5->25->100) and emits audit events for each step
Automated rollback triggers on any of: >5% increase in request error rate, p99 latency increase >15% vs baseline, or token-cost regressions beyond configured guardrails
Console shows recommendations with rationale (top contributing signals) and a one-click approve/apply workflow for authorized users
